trial_court: Family Court, Lucknow — Case No. - 2189 of 2010
case_name: Sanjay Mishra S/O Satya Narain Mishra v. Principal Judge, Family Court, Lucknow

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sanjay Mishra S/O Satya Narain Mishra (husband)

facts_of_case: Petitioner's wife filed an application under Section 151 CPC before the Family Court to set aside a judgment and decree dated 22.10.2008. A restraint order was passed on 13.1.2010 without notice or hearing to the petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking vacation of an order must be given a hearing.
legal_principles.held: Counsel for the petitioner submitted that the interest of justice would suffice if the hearing of the Misc. Case No. 21 of 2009 is expedited and the application for vacation is heard on the date fixed i.e. 9.7.2010.

outcome.final_order: The Family Court is directed to make earnest endeavour to dispose of the application by 9.7.2010 and in case, the same is not disposed of on that date, it shall be disposed of by 31st July, 2010.
